I know that maize grows better in our savanna land when you give it some fertilizer, so I will buy a few bags of subsidized NPK from the market town to spread on this plot. But I cannot afford improved seed this season—I will plant the local maize seed we saved from last year’s harvest. My children and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves by hand, because paying workers is too expensive for us right now.
